items.title: Is Nvidia's AI data center dominance slipping as the market expands?
items.summary: Moor Insights & Strategy founder, CEO, and chief analyst Patrick Moorhead speaks with Josh Lipton about Nvidia's (NVDA) biggest competition in AI data centers, as he anticipates the company's market share could fall to 70% from 90% over the next two years.

items.title: Nvidia, Meta, Revolution Medicines, Abercrombie, Intuit, Salesforce, Moderna, and More Stocks That Explain Today’s Market
items.summary: Stocks traded modestly lower Wednesday ahead of Nvidia’s earnings report and after the personal consumption expenditures index, or PCE, for July revealed inflation was a bit stronger than expected.  Intel  rose o.9% and  Broadcom  declined 0.3% with investors in wait-and-see mode when it comes to chip stocks.  Nvidia  reported earnings after the bell, and shares rose about 4%.
